newsitem.title: ESTONIA: HANSA, FOREKS HELP BOURSE TO NEW RECORDS.
newsitem.headline: HANSA, FOREKS HELP BOURSE TO NEW RECORDS.

text.p: * Total trade by close 111.5 million kroons.
* Talse index sets new record: 302.29, up 1.56 percent.
* 19 stocks traded, four steady, 14 up, one down.
* Hansapank was up 2.1 kroons to 168.50 on trade
of 19.2 mln kroons.
* Forekspank rises on revised profit estimate of
96.4 mln kroons to close 2.75 kroons up at 201.10 kroons.
* Privatisation securities on free list (EVPs) were most
traded on 48.1 mln kroons, up to 0.43 kroons from 0.385 kroons.
The bourse index crossed the 300
boundary for the first time as buying interest in Hansapank and
Forekspank kept shares on an upward roll.
"There are lots of buyers and not many sellers about and the
prices of most stocks were forced higher," one trader said.
"But we do expect a correction, especially in Hansa and
Hoiupank, but we can't say when it will happen," he added.
Total trade on the main list was 53.8 million kroons with
the Talse index 1.53 percent higher at 302.29.
"Crossing the 300 level is a good thing to promote the
bourse but most investors are more interested in how much they
made," one trader said.
Most dealers have been expecting a correction for the last
three days and say it is too hard to pick the bourse's
direction.
Hansapank led the main list to rise by 2.1 kroons to close
at 168.50 kroons on trade of 19.2 million kroons.
Hansapank in Helsinki also reached a new high,
closing up 1.1 markka at 63.10 markka on volume of 2.1 million
markka.
"The buying interest in Hansa is holding, while in Helsinki
the bid/ask was 63.10/64.00, so tomorrow will depend on what
dealers have on their books to start the day," a dealer said.
Forekspank released a revised profit forecast for 1997 of
96.4 million kroons to changes the price's direction from
yesrterday's drop.
It closed up 2.75 kroons up at 201.10 on trade of 12 million
kroons.
"A higher forecast was expected, but it is a conservative,
reachable number," on trader said.
"Forekspank is still a cheap stock on the bourse, so it is
hard to say how far it could go," one trader said.
On the free market, privatisation securities dominated with
48.1 million kroons traded. They again closed higher on 0.43
kroons compared to 0.385 kroons on Tuesday.
"There are no sellers at all and the price just keeps on
rising," one trader said.
"There were some larger blocks of 10 million vouchers and
these helped to push the price higher," another dealer said.
Demand has been high for the compensation vouchers as
investors anticipate the sale of stakes in Eesti Gaas and Hotel
Olympia for vouchers.
